input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for review, movie. Data is persisted through a structured data access layer.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to interact with movie functionality, so that I can accomplish my movie-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with review functionality, so that I can accomplish my review-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use review capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to use movie capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
